card.line: Debir, also called Kiriath-sepher, was a city in the hill country of Judah that Israel captured under Joshua and that Othniel later took for Caleb's daughter.

moments.title: Joshua conquers Debir
moments.text: Joshua and all Israel turned toward Debir and fought against it. They captured the city, its king, and its villages, and left no survivors, as they had done at Hebron and Libnah.

moments.title: Caleb marches on Debir
moments.text: Caleb marched against the people of Debir, which used to be called Kiriath-sepher. He promised his daughter Acsah in marriage to the man who would capture it, and Othniel did.

moments.title: Acsah asks for springs
moments.text: Acsah asked her father Caleb for a blessing. Since he had given her land in the Negev, she asked for springs of water too, and he gave her the upper and lower springs.
